pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-rectangular dark regions with soft-edged pixel gradients. Individual patches show moderate spatial area on the flank, becoming smaller and more densely packed toward the cranial section of the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological lattice. The network consists of high-frequency junction nodes with variable pixel thickness, widening towards the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal-cervical line, consistent with a short, dense mane structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark, horizontal linear lesion/scar located on the mid-upper flank, characterized by a localized disruption of the hair pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple avian organisms (oxpeckers) localized on the anterior shoulder and lower neck region.
